description: Allowlisted summaries of frozen local receipts; raw reports remain local because they include host paths and transcripts.
limits: One run per requested model and case per attempt; not a success-rate estimate or model ranking.
Baseline evaluator differs from outcome-proof-v2; scores are not directly comparable.
Model identifiers are requested API names, not attested backend revisions.
Binary and spec hashes do not cover provider infrastructure or the local toolchain.

Baseline and attempts 01-03 shared a Cargo target; a controlled audit reproduced stale passing tests for unchanged failing source. Preserve those reported scores as history, not verified Rust source correctness.
